items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Authorize no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but retained cost records conflict and infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are incomplete. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are not calculable. Continue only the existing attribution and cost reconciliation work; do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance metrics, or AI usage as financial returns. Minimum measurement is period-aligned attributable revenue by tracking ID and site/content, a reconciled AI-cost ledger, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/approved-budget/experiment-cost records, and an explicit learning-outcome and cost-to-learn threshold.
